list.title: Events
list.emptyPast: No archived events match these filters.

detail.registeredOf: nobody registered out of {capacity} | {n} registered out of {capacity} | {n} registered out of {capacity}
detail.cancelNotice: All members will be notified, along with the reason.
detail.accountsText: Purchases, bar sales, other costs and income, receipts.

form.editHint: Changing the date notifies everyone registered.
form.createHint: All members will be notified, then reminded 7 days before; registered members 1 day before.
form.title: Title
form.locationHint: Full address: visible to members, and to guests once their answer is confirmed.
form.public: Open to the public (answer without an account)
form.publicHint: A public page is created, to share (Facebook, poster…). It shows the city, never the address or the participants’ names.

card.placesLeft: no places left | {n} place left | {n} places left

calendar.title: Club calendar in my own calendar
calendar.intro: Subscribe your calendar (Google, Apple, Outlook…) to the club’s events: it updates itself. The link is personal, so don’t share it. Generating a new one disables the old one.

poster.label: Poster (optional)
poster.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, 10 MB at most. Shown to members in the calendar.
poster.removed: The poster will be removed when you save.
poster.tooLarge: Image too large: 10 MB at most.
poster.wrongType: Unsupported format: JPEG, PNG or WebP.

share.title: Public page
share.text: Anyone, even without an account, can answer “I’m coming” or “Not sure” there. Only the city ({city}) is shown.

guests.title: Guests without an account ({count})
guests.privacy: These addresses are only used for this event; they are deleted 30 days after it.
guests.removeNotice: Their answer is deleted and their place freed. The action is recorded in the log.

audience.title: Announcement audience
audience.method: Each person counts once: members exactly (by their account), anonymous visitors as an estimate (same network and same browser). No cookies; organizers and bots excluded.
audience.closed: Measurement ended (30 days after the event): figures are final.
audience.archived: Detail deleted after 13 months: only totals are kept.

qrPoster.title: QR poster
qrPoster.intro: Put it on the tables during club nights: one scan opens the website, or the evening’s page to reply.
qrPoster.noPublicEvening: No upcoming public evening: only the website poster is available.
qrPoster.inkDarkHint: in the club’s colours, for a print shop
qrPoster.printHint: Test the QR code with your phone before putting it up.

accounts.title: Evening accounts
accounts.rights: Kept by the secretary and the treasurer · every change is recorded in the log
accounts.readOnly: Read only: the secretary and the treasurer keep the accounts.
accounts.closeText: No more changes will be possible; the treasurer can reopen them.
accounts.barLegend: Returned: sent back to the supplier and refunded · Left: kept or given away

fields.label: Name
fields.entryActualHint: Leave empty until it is known

accounts.receiptsPrivacy: Visible to the board only · kept for 6 years
accounts.addReceipt: Add a photo or a PDF
accounts.receiptFileHint: Receipt, invoice, credit note: 10 MB at most.
accounts.temporaryBar: Temporary bar authorised by the town hall
accounts.countersHint: Two separate limits: 5 temporary bar authorisations a year (public health), 6 tax-exempt fundraising events (tax).

publicEvent.going: nobody is coming yet | {n} person is coming | {n} people are coming
publicEvent.member: You are a member: answer from {link} instead.
publicEvent.name: First name or nickname
publicEvent.emailHint: To confirm your answer and warn you of any change. Never shown.
publicEvent.consent: I agree that Skull Darts 71 uses my first name and email for this event only ({link}).
publicEvent.sent: If {email} is valid, an email is on its way: click its link to confirm your answer (within 48 hours).
publicEvent.closed: Answers are closed for this event.

guestResponse.invalid: This link is not (or no longer) valid.
guestResponse.pending: {name}, you answered “{answer}”. Confirm so that it counts.
guestResponse.expired: This link has expired: send your answer again from the event page.
guestResponse.removed: Your answer is withdrawn and your data deleted.
guestResponse.keepEmail: Keep the email you received: its link brings you back here.

publicEvents.intro: No membership needed: pick an event and answer “I’m coming” or “Not sure”.

carousel.title: All our events
carousel.intro: From the next one to the oldest, open to everyone: answer “I’m coming” or “Not sure”, no account needed.
carousel.label: Events open to everyone, from the next one to the oldest

publicEvents.empty: No event open to the public at the moment. Come back soon!
publicEvents.members: Member? {link} to see the club’s full calendar.
